_comment: Exemptions for scripts/dead-commands.mjs: commands that look uncalled but are not, or are kept on purpose.
An entry skips the command in every category, so give the exact reason and the ticket that removes it.

exempt.prepare_emoji_text: The sender-side check for the #848 emoji use rule, documented as enforced but never called (#1808). Kept until send and edit apply it inside pollis-core; then delete it.
exempt.delete_group: Registered on desktop for parity debt: mobile deletes groups, desktop has no UI for it yet (scripts/feature-parity.json known_debt.mobile_only).
exempt.get_dm_channel: Registered on desktop for parity debt: mobile reads one DM, desktop does not yet (scripts/feature-parity.json known_debt.mobile_only).
exempt.list_known_accounts: Mobile bridge arm kept for parity debt: desktop's account picker uses it, mobile has none yet (scripts/feature-parity.json known_debt.desktop_only).
exempt.read_messages_after: Mobile bridge arm kept for parity debt: desktop's jump-to-message paging uses it, mobile has none yet (scripts/feature-parity.json known_debt.desktop_only).
exempt.read_messages_around: Mobile bridge arm kept for parity debt: desktop's jump-to-message uses it, mobile has none yet (scripts/feature-parity.json known_debt.desktop_only).
exempt.rebuild_search_index: Mobile bridge arm kept for parity debt: desktop's Preferences offers the rebuild, mobile does not yet (scripts/feature-parity.json known_debt.desktop_only).
